phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Business Foundations & Financial Literacy — Build quantitative foundations, explore finance career pathways, and develop professional identity.

milestones.label: Complete CliftonStrengths assessment and finance career mapping
milestones.description: Complete the Gallup CliftonStrengths assessment and connect signature themes to finance career pathways including investment banking, corporate finance, wealth management, and fintech. Students develop a strengths-based career exploration plan.

milestones.label: Master financial accounting fundamentals
milestones.description: Introduction to financial statements, the accounting cycle, and GAAP. Students build the accounting literacy essential for financial analysis and investment valuation in upper-division finance courses.

milestones.label: Build quantitative reasoning foundations
milestones.description: Develop the calculus foundations required for financial modeling, derivatives pricing, and quantitative analysis. Emphasis on functions, limits, derivatives, and optimization problems applied to business contexts.

milestones.label: Join Financial Management Association or Investment Club
milestones.description: Research and join a CoBE-affiliated finance organization such as the Financial Management Association, Student Investment Club, or National Association of Securities Professionals student chapter.

milestones.label: Analyze global economic forces shaping financial markets
milestones.description: Examine macroeconomic principles including monetary policy, interest rates, inflation, and international trade that directly influence financial markets and investment decisions.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Finance Knowledge & Market Exposure — Deepen corporate finance and investment skills, engage with industry professionals.

milestones.label: Master corporate finance principles
milestones.description: Time value of money, capital budgeting, cost of capital, capital structure decisions, and dividend policy. Students analyze real company financial decisions using discounted cash flow models and NPV analysis.

milestones.label: Complete Bloomberg Market Concepts certification
milestones.description: Complete the Bloomberg Market Concepts (BMC) self-paced certification covering economic indicators, currencies, fixed income, and equities using the Bloomberg Terminal in the CoBE Finance Lab.

milestones.label: Attend CoBE career fair and finance industry recruiting events
milestones.description: Participate in CoBE-sponsored career fairs and finance industry recruiting events with banks, asset management firms, and financial services companies. Practice elevator pitches and submit targeted resumes.

milestones.label: Analyze international financial markets
milestones.description: Study investment theory including portfolio construction, asset pricing models (CAPM, APT), and market efficiency. Students analyze domestic and international equity, fixed income, and derivative markets.

milestones.label: Build financial modeling proficiency
milestones.description: Develop advanced Excel financial models including three-statement models, sensitivity analysis, and scenario planning. Students analyze publicly traded companies using ratio analysis and valuation multiples.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Finance & Portfolio Management — Build portfolio management expertise, secure mentorship, and complete summer internship.

milestones.label: Manage student investment fund portfolio
milestones.description: Participate in the CoBE Student Managed Investment Fund, conducting equity research, presenting stock pitches, and making real investment decisions. Students apply modern portfolio theory and risk management frameworks.

milestones.label: Begin CFA Level I preparation
milestones.description: Coursework aligned with CFA Level I curriculum covering ethics, quantitative methods, financial reporting, and equity valuation. Students register for the CFA Institute University Affiliation Program.

milestones.label: Secure and engage with an industry mentor
milestones.description: Establish a formal mentorship relationship with a finance professional through the CoBE Alumni Mentor Network or industry partner program. Meet monthly and document career guidance and market insights.

milestones.label: Complete summer finance internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete a structured internship at a bank, investment firm, insurance company, or corporate finance department. Students apply financial analysis skills in a professional setting and submit a comprehensive reflection.

milestones.label: Study international finance and foreign exchange
milestones.description: Analyze international financial management topics including foreign exchange markets, currency risk hedging, international capital budgeting, and cross-border mergers and acquisitions.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Career Placement & Capstone — Finalize professional readiness, complete capstone project, and launch finance career.

milestones.label: Execute capstone financial consulting project
milestones.description: Collaborate with a client organization to analyze a financial challenge, conduct valuation analysis, and deliver professional recommendations. Projects are evaluated by faculty and industry professionals.

milestones.label: Complete salary negotiation and offer evaluation training
milestones.description: Participate in negotiation workshops covering compensation analysis, benefits evaluation, and offer comparison for finance industry positions. Students develop personal compensation strategy documents.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor for underclassmen
milestones.description: Serve as a peer mentor for first- or second-year finance students, facilitating study groups, sharing internship strategies, and modeling professional behavior within the Investment Club or FMA.

milestones.label: Develop industry-specific placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a comprehensive career launch package targeting investment banking, asset management, or corporate finance sectors. Includes tailored resume, technical interview preparation, and network map of contacts.

milestones.label: Complete exit competency assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoBE Finance Exit Assessment measuring competency across program learning outcomes. Finalize career activation status documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or CFA exam registration.
